objectives.name: Authority lineage
objectives.description: Find where controlling commercial/legal/operational authority enters the state transition and whether alternate paths bypass it.

objectives.name: Completeness proof
objectives.description: Determine whether an evidence set can prove global/subject completeness rather than only validate present artifacts.

objectives.name: Ambiguity reconciliation
objectives.description: Find response-loss/restart/UNKNOWN boundaries and prove whether reissue is safe before repeating physical or financial actions.

objectives.name: Independent evaluation
objectives.description: Find evaluators/outcome sources independent enough to falsify the target system's own claims.

objectives.name: Exactly-once settlement
objectives.description: Trace durable monetary intent, ambiguous provider outcomes, reversals and final settlement without double application.

objectives.name: Identity and correlation lineage
objectives.description: Establish stable event/entity identity and provenance required for joins, blocking and replay.

objectives.name: Runtime side-effect trace
objectives.description: Trace a decision/claim through the exact executable path that mutates trusted state or an external system.

objectives.name: Current rule authority
objectives.description: Verify effective-dated rule/currentness semantics against dated first-party authority.

objectives.name: Research-to-production lineage
objectives.description: Trace a method from paper/research artifact to hardened production descendant while preserving core invariants.

objectives.name: Emergence triangulation
objectives.description: Measure independent convergence of a capability across research, code, standards/packages and production systems.

objectives.name: Ingestion durability
objectives.description: Intersect source topology, historical durability and truthful run/source-health state.

objectives.name: Protocol regression
objectives.description: Mine compatibility defects, migration contracts and regression evidence for protocol/integration readiness.
